journeys.name: Model a product from accepted intent
journeys.outcome: Create/reconcile stable product identity, hierarchy, requirements and accepted baseline, then retrieve the same model after restart

journeys.name: Traverse product to implementation and evidence
journeys.outcome: Start from product/capability/requirement and boundedly reach linked implementation, tests and evidence with provenance

journeys.name: Detect product dissatisfaction
journeys.outcome: Ingest scoped evidence, assess against accepted intent, and surface a correctly classified dissatisfaction finding

journeys.name: Resolve and re-verify dissatisfaction
journeys.outcome: Link a finding to external resolution work, ingest new evidence, and update product state without conflating work completion with acceptance

journeys.name: Measure VP-stage readiness
journeys.outcome: Select a VP stage and derive FR completion, blockers, feature/journey closure and truthful readiness

journeys.name: Explain what 'percent done' means
journeys.outcome: Decompose raw mature completeness into stage readiness, structural shape, closure, survivability and transition burden

journeys.name: Assess a changed baseline
journeys.outcome: Propose/accept a baseline change, invalidate affected evidence, compute impact and reassess only admissible proof

journeys.name: Represent externally managed work without owning it
journeys.outcome: Project AgilePlus/external work references into product context while preserving external work authority

journeys.name: Use Tracera locally and offline
journeys.outcome: Install/start a durable local workspace, complete core product journeys, restart and retain canonical state without mandatory cloud dependency

journeys.name: Use Tracera through an agent interface
journeys.outcome: Query bounded product context, propose changes and inspect grade/finding state without bypassing mutation authority

journeys.name: Audit historical product state
journeys.outcome: Select a prior baseline/time window and replay intent, evidence, findings and decisions without rewriting history

journeys.name: Publish a release proof
journeys.outcome: Bind exact source/artifact/environment/verifier evidence to release obligations and prevent promotion on missing or mismatched proof
